versions.subject: adding Petitpotam host detections
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4768
    Account_Name|endswith: '$'
    Certificate_Thumbprint: '*'
filter_local:
    Client_Address: '::1'
    
condition: selection and not filter_local

versions.subject: filter: empty thumbprint, PetitPotam rule

selection:
    EventID: 4768
    TargetUserName|endswith: '$'
    CertThumbprint: '*'
filter_local:
    IpAddress: '::1'
filter_thumbprint:

condition: selection and not filter_local and not filter_thumbprint
